The named claimants in the reporting are individuals and micro-businesses (a poultry farmer, plastics moulders that lost a day of feedstock and a delivery contract), not listed companies. All ten hop1 candidates (POSCO, Samsung C&T, SK, LS Electric, Hyundai E&C, Hyundai Rotem, Kumho Petrochemical, Vedanta, Lucky Cement, PLN) are large industrials of exactly the type reported as unaffected.

ground_truth_affected_note: No named downstream consumer (refiner, precursor maker, cell maker or OEM) could be tied to a specific sourced impact statement. The documented downstream effect is market-level: Chinese imports of cobalt intermediates, China being the dominant buyer of Congolese output, fell more than 90% year on year by August 2025, and the cobalt price recovered roughly 35% from the February low of about USD 10/lb to about USD 15.80/lb. Of the 18 hop1 candidates, the plausible ones on product grounds are the cobalt refiners and precursor makers (Umicore, CNGR Advanced Material, GEM, Electra Battery Materials) and the cell makers (Samsung SDI, CATL, SK Innovation); I found no statement from any of them attributing an impact to this event.
